title: Young Man Studying at Library Desk, 1956 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-century black-and-white photograph capturing a focused young man writing and studying diligently at a library table. Illuminated by a long attached table lamp, he is dressed in a plaid button-up shirt with his sleeves rolled up, bent over study materials and an open book. Rows of bound books and a large window fill the background, reflecting 1950s higher education and academic life. The white border features classic deckled edges and a processing date stamp of April 1956 along the bottom.
